subject: Risk & Compliance
title: What Is Sovereign Risk
description: A 60-second lesson on What Is Sovereign Risk.

hook.text: Argentina has defaulted on its debt nine times. Lenders keep lending. Argentina keeps defaulting. The cycle continues.

buildup.text: Sovereign risk is the danger that a government will fail to meet its financial obligations — default on its debt.

discovery.text: Credit rating agencies assess sovereign risk on a scale from AAA (safest) to D (default).

twist.text: Even rich countries carry sovereign risk. The US debt ceiling crisis in 2023 briefly rattled global markets.

climax.text: Sovereign risk affects every business operating in or lending to a country. It's the foundation of country risk.

punchline.text: Nine defaults. Lenders return. Argentina defaults again.

quiz.question: What is sovereign risk?
options: The danger a government will default on its debt
Risk that a king will be overthrown
Risk of investing in private companies
